description_en: Asynchronously triggers skill execution and immediately returns a RunId
description_zh: 异步触发技能执行，立即返回 RunId
name: RunSkill

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. If not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数，缺省时使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The skill code (globally unique). This parameter takes priority over skillName
parameters.help_zh: 技能编码（全局唯一），优先级高于skillName
parameters.name: skill_code

parameters.help_en: The skill name. Used when skillCode is not specified. The name must be unique within the tenant scope
parameters.help_zh: 技能名称，未传 skillCode 时使用；租户范围内必须唯一
parameters.name: skill_name

parameters.help_en: The placeholder variable value that stores the error message for a fault
parameters.help_zh: 保存错误信息的占位变量值
parameters.name: arguments

parameters.help_en: The digital worker name. Used to calculate the CodeAgent allowedSkills whitelist based on binding relationships
parameters.help_zh: 数字员工名称；用于按绑定关系计算CodeAgent allowedSkills 白名单
parameters.name: operating_object_name

parameters.help_en: The abstract model name (model tier). Defaults to standard if not specified
parameters.help_zh: 抽象模型名（模型档位），不传默认standard
parameters.name: model

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token generated by the caller. In the current version, this value is only recorded in metadata and is not used for deduplication
parameters.help_zh: 幂等 token，调用方自行生成；当前版本仅记录到 metadata，未做去重
parameters.name: client_token

schema.description_en: The asynchronous task was queued successfully

createdAt.description_en: The task creation time in ISO 8601 UTC format
createdAt.description_zh: 任务创建时间，ISO8601 UTC 格式

message.example: The current zone list is illegal.

runId.description_en: The asynchronous task ID, used for querying with getSkillRun
runId.description_zh: 异步任务 ID，用于 getSkillRun 查询

skillCode.description_en: The skill code that was actually executed

status.description_en: The task status. Returns Running immediately upon submission
status.description_zh: 任务状态：提交即返回 Running
